home.intro: I build end-to-end web applications — from responsive interfaces in React and Next.js to REST APIs and the databases behind them. Currently at {company} in Bangkok.
home.aboutBody: I'm a developer who likes making complicated systems feel simple. Most of my day is spent between a Next.js front end and a NestJS back end, wiring up real-time data, hardware integrations and dashboards that people actually have to use at work.

about.title: Profile
about.subtitle: The longer version — background, experience and what I'm good at.
about.summaryBody: Full-stack developer with {years}+ years of experience designing and developing complex web applications. Skilled in front-end technologies (React, Next.js, TypeScript) and back-end development (Node.js, NestJS, MySQL, PostgreSQL). Currently at {company}, responsible for end-to-end web application development including UI collaboration, RESTful APIs and database management.

thanes.summary: Responsible for front-end development and UI design, as well as building APIs for back-end integration. Experienced in delivering end-to-end features through close collaboration between front end and back end to ensure seamless data flow, system functionality and maintainability.
